findings.detail: The fair-value completeness universe includes commitment schedule rows whose source columns are total/funded/expired/unfunded commitment, not fair value.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The raw filing's current investment schedule provides a fair value column and ties to Total Non-controlled/Non-affiliated investments fair value of 533,065,800 in table 45 row 19. The residual population is localized to adjacent commitment schedules, exemplified by table 46, whose header is Total Commitment/Funded Commitment/Expired Commitment/Unfunded Commitment and has no fair value column. Treating those commitment rows as fair-value holdings leaves is a real extraction/classification defect, not a source omission.
